newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine Jan to June 15 budget surplus 4.52 bln.
newsitem.headline: Philippine Jan to June 15 budget surplus 4.52 bln.

text.p: The Philippines' January to June 15 budget surplus was at 4.52 billion pesos, down from a target of 8.82 billion, finance secretary Roberto De Ocampo said on Wednesday.
The government's revenues in the January to June 15 period reached 196.1 billion pesos, lower than earlier forecast of 207.4 billion.
De Ocampo attributed the shortfall to the government's failure to implement a new tax reform system, lower-than-expected imports and a tariff cut on imports.
De Ocampo also said the country's consolidated public sector generated a surplus of 541 million in the first three months of the year against forecast of a 5.7-billion peso deficit.
The stonger public sector position is due to a lower-than-programmed deficit of the national government, lower interest rates and higher contributions to government pension funds.
This resulted to a rise in public sector savings to 30.2 billion in the first quarter from the year-ago 24.3 billion.
